attempts.why: Scope dropdown button styling to direct child summary so nested accordion summary inside dropdown ul does not inherit dropdown select borders/marker/layout.

selfVerify.reason: Inner accordion summary 'Solid (accordion)' inside dropdown ul no longer renders with outer dropdown select button border/background/marker - shows as plain list item with own disclosure caret only, dropdown panel open correctly without double-border/caret leak.

pick.suspected: Nested details selectors are not scoped with direct-child combinators, so the .dropdown summary/panel rules leak onto the inner accordion details/summary inside the dropdown ul, making the accordion summary render with dropdown button styling/layout (double border/caret) and broken panel behavior.
